responsibility: This file is the central implementation of the AArch64 SVE ACLE builtin framework. It defines the static metadata for SVE vector, mode, and type suffixes; registers builtin types and function declarations; manages lookup tables of resolved and overloaded builtin forms; handles name mangling, overload resolution support, GIMPLE folding, RTL expansion dispatch, pragma-driven arm_sve.h injection, fixed-length arm_sve_vector_bits type variants, and front-end type-context validation for sizeless SVE types.
same_name_distinction: In the aarch64-sve-builtins trio, this is the central framework implementation: it builds and registers SVE types and builtin declarations, manages lookup and overload machinery, and drives checking, folding, expansion dispatch, and type-context handling. The sibling .def file is the generated-data source, and the .h file defines the shared interfaces and metadata types.
